- Have Marissa (VP product) lead the exec segment and Naomi (solution lead) cover the technical walkthrough, or
- Shift the demo 45 minutes earlier (complicated for your APAC timezone team).

Given the short notice, we recommend option 1. Marissa and Naomi — can you confirm availability to step in and whether you’re comfortable presenting the CIO-facing slides and the live Q&A? I’ve attached the latest run_of_show.pdf and attendee_list.csv so you can see the ask.

Kenji, would you be OK with us recording the session if needed (we’ll mask any customer-sensitive snippets and won’t circulate without sign-off)? If you prefer no recording, we’ll ensure full notes and a follow-up short Q&A slot with your team.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm presenter lead (yes/no) and slide handoff plan
- Naomi: confirm you can run the demo lab and own the technical Q&A
- Kenji: confirm recording consent or ask for no-record

Thanks — sorry for the scramble, we’ll keep it tight.

Best,
